How to play

Finish three laps ahead of the pack. Signed shortcuts rejoin the course; checkpoints still count.

Accelerate / brake
W / ↑S / ↓

Drift: hold Shift + turn. Steer into the corner to tighten the slide; countersteer to open it. Release at blue or gold sparks for turbo.
Jump: hit a ramp, then tap Shift in the air for a trick and a landing boost.
Draft: stay close behind a rival to charge a slipstream boost.
Coins: collect up to 10 for extra top speed.

Surge — a burst of straight-line speed.

Seeker — a pulse that hunts the racer ahead.

Slick — a slippery trap dropped behind you.

For a launch boost, start accelerating just as the countdown reaches 1. Auto accelerate is available in the main menu. Landscape gives you a wider view.
